verify.note: Per main-loop pass of each recording (up to 20000 frames; Docking whole): the patched build on a Next model against the original, registers (no I, no R), banks 0-7 outside the documented exclusions and the game's port writes; the first render of each pass at full weight against that pass's mono buffer (XOR overlaps classified exactly). Unit tests: recolour exact, negative h_clear, R sequence, ISR pattern and render controls caught; boot check of both builds.

status.title: Elite
status.build: elite_sprites.nex: the viewport on Layer 2 in colour (ship models, planet, sun, stars, lasers each their own colour), the game's logic pass at 28 MHz on a 10-frame tick with a 50 fps render between passes (interpolated ships, planet, stars, own turning), the condition light as a hardware sprite; elite.nex the plain build (IM 2 fix only)
status.software: auto, 5 recordings: every pass exact against the original (Docking whole, the others to frame 20000: 1434 + 213 + 8988 + 11613 + 17505 passes), full-weight renders equal the pass's buffer except classified XOR overlaps; negative controls caught; boot check both builds
status.next: CSpect and hardware check of the colours, interpolation and the 50 fps cadence; tune the tick (T = 10) and the ISR pattern on hardware

techniques.target: the game's buffer writers (RST / JP into the alt ROM) mirror every changed bit to a Layer 2 back buffer in the figure's colour; the 0x7FBE copy and the ULA viewport are replaced
one render per frame between passes: the ship draw (0xA6DF) on interpolated copies, game RAM saved and restored around it
HLIB_IFF_DI in h_plot, poll and stsave; h_isr keeps slot 0's page and the interrupted IFF

pacing.coverage: Five recordings whole (7.5k-68.6k frames): frames and interrupts per pass; no JNext or hardware timing.
pacing.result: About 10 frames per pass (5 updates a second), 0.58-0.67 interrupts per frame; the engine ticks every 10 frames and runs the game ISR body on 16 of 25 frames.

dependencies.coverage: Every buffer writer of the five recordings; ship draw inputs and outputs (draw_deps.py); Reidquat / Witch / Havoc / Police fills found by verifier misses.
dependencies.result: The logic pass draws into the mono buffer as the original; the renderer reruns the game's ship draw on interpolated copies and restores what it wrote.

feasibility.decision: Owner's brief 2026-11-22: coloured ships, details 1-5, pacing (i) interpolate; the game's logic and speed unchanged.
feasibility.next_experiment: Hardware: 50 fps render cadence and colours; pass-to-pass time within 5% of the 10-frame tick over 300 passes.

results.scope: Docking whole, Witch / Havoc / PoliceAnarchy / Reidquat to frame 20000 (2026-11-23): all passes exact, renders exact bar classified XOR overlaps, negative controls caught.
